title: LaSDAICVI: Children's Spanish Voice Commands Dataset
description:
LaSDAICVI (LaSDAI Comandos de Voz Infantil) is a keyword-spotting dataset of Spanish speech recorded from 41 primary-school children aged 8 to 11 in Tucaní, Mérida state, Venezuela. It contains 29,061 isolated-word recordings (16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM WAV) of 60 keywords: the digits 0–9, the 32 results of the multiplication tables 2–9, and 18 voice commands.

The release includes per-sample metadata (speaker ID, gender, age, grade), the official speaker-independent train/validation/test splits used in the thesis, background-noise clips for data augmentation, and the full B.Sc. thesis describing the recording protocol and baseline keyword-spotting models.

Parents signed an informed consent form and each child signed an informed assent. The recordings are of minors: use them only for non-commercial research and education, do not attempt to identify participants, and do not use them for speaker identification, voice cloning or voice synthesis.

Created at the Laboratorio de Sistemas Discretos, Automatización e Integración (LaSDAI), Universidad de los Andes, Mérida, Venezuela.
